verses.sa: व्रात्य आसीदीयमान एव स प्रजापतिं समैरयत् ॥
verses.rom: vratya asidiyamana eva sa prajapatim samairayat ||
verses.en: A Vrātya there was, just going about; he stirred up Prajāpati.

verses.sa: स प्रजापतिः सुवर्णमात्मन्न् अपश्यत्तत्प्राजनयत् ॥
verses.rom: sa prajapatih suvarnamatmann apashyattatprajanayat ||
verses.en: He, Prajāpati, saw in himself gold (suvárṇa); he generated that.

verses.sa: तदेकमभवत्तल्ललाममभवत्तन् महदभवत्तज्ज्येष्ठमभवत्तद्ब्रह्माभवत्तत्तपोऽभवत्तत्सत्यमभवत्तेन प्राजायत ॥
verses.rom: tadekamabhavattallalamamabhavattan mahadabhavattajjyeshthamabhavattadbrahmabhavattattapo'bhavattatsatyamabhavattena prajayata ||
verses.en: That became one; that became star-marked (lalā́ma); that became great; that became chief; that became bráhman; that became fervor; that became truth; therewith he had progeny.

verses.sa: सोऽवर्धत स महान् अभवत्स महादेवोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom: so'vardhata sa mahan abhavatsa mahadevo'bhavat ||
verses.en: He increased; he became great; he became the great god (mahādevá).

verses.sa: स देवानामीशां पर्यैत्स ईशानोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom: sa devanamisham paryaitsa ishano'bhavat ||
verses.en: He compassed the lordship of the gods; he became the Lord (ī́çāna).

verses.sa: स एकव्रात्योऽभवत्स धनुरादत्त तदेवेन्द्रधनुः ॥
verses.rom: sa ekavratyo'bhavatsa dhanuradatta tadevendradhanuh ||
verses.en: He became the sole Vrātya; he took to himself a bow; that was Indra's bow.

verses.sa: नीलमस्योदरं लोहितं पृष्ठम् ॥
verses.rom: nilamasyodaram lohitam prishtham ||
verses.en: Blue its belly, red [its] back.

verses.sa: नीलेनैवाप्रियं भ्रातृव्यं प्रोर्णोति लोहितेन द्विषन्तं विध्यतीति ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति ॥
verses.rom: nilenaivapriyam bhratrivyam prornoti lohitena dvishantam vidhyatiti brahmavadino vadanti ||
verses.en: With the blue he envelops (pra-vṛ) a hostile cousin, with the red he pierces one hating him [—he who knows thus]: so say the theologians (brahmavādín) .

verses.sa: स उदतिष्ठत्स प्राचीं दिशमनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom: sa udatishthatsa prachim dishamanu vyachalat ||

verses.sa: तं बृहच्च रथन्तरं चादित्याश्च विश्वे च देवा अनुव्यचलन् ॥
verses.rom: tam brihachcha rathantaram chadityashcha vishve cha deva anuvyachalan ||

verses.sa: बृहते च वै स रथन्तराय चादित्येभ्यश्च विश्वेभ्यश्च देवेभ्य आ वृश्चते य एवं विद्वांसं व्रात्यमुपवदति ॥
verses.rom: brihate cha vai sa rathantaraya chadityebhyashcha vishvebhyashcha devebhya a vrishchate ya evam vidvamsam vratyamupavadati ||

verses.sa: बृहतश्च वै स रथन्तरस्य चादित्यानां च विश्वेषां च देवानां प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: brihatashcha vai sa rathantarasya chadityanam cha vishvesham cha devanam priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: तस्य प्राच्यां दिशि श्रद्धा पुंश्चली मित्रो मागधो विज्ञानं वासोऽहरुष्णीषं रात्री केशा हरितौ प्रवर्तौ कल्मलिर्मणिः ॥
verses.rom: tasya prachyam dishi shraddha pumshchali mitro magadho vijnanam vaso'harushnisham ratri kesha haritau pravartau kalmalirmanih ||

verses.sa: भूतं च भविष्यच्च परिष्कन्दौ मनो विपथं ॥
verses.rom: bhutam cha bhavishyachcha parishkandau mano vipatham ||

verses.sa: मातरिश्वा च पवमानश्च विपथवाहौ वातः सारथी रेष्मा प्रतोदः ॥
verses.rom: matarishva cha pavamanashcha vipathavahau vatah sarathi reshma pratodah ||

verses.sa:
कीर्तिश्च यशश्च पुरःसरौ
ऐनं कीर्तिर्गच्छत्या यशो गच्छति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
kirtishcha yashashcha purahsarau
ainam kirtirgachchhatya yasho gachchhati ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: स उदतिष्ठत्स दक्षिणां दिशमनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom: sa udatishthatsa dakshinam dishamanu vyachalat ||

verses.sa: तं यज्ञायज्ञियं च वामदेव्यं च यज्ञश्च यजमानश्च पशवश्चानुव्यचलन् ॥
verses.rom: tam yajnayajniyam cha vamadevyam cha yajnashcha yajamanashcha pashavashchanuvyachalan ||

verses.sa: यज्ञायज्ञियाय च वै स वामदेव्याय च यज्ञाय च यजमानाय च पशुभ्यश्चा वृश्चते य एवं विद्वांसं व्रात्यमुपवदति ॥
verses.rom: yajnayajniyaya cha vai sa vamadevyaya cha yajnaya cha yajamanaya cha pashubhyashcha vrishchate ya evam vidvamsam vratyamupavadati ||

verses.sa: यज्ञायज्ञियस्य च वै स वामदेव्यस्य च यज्ञस्य च यजमानस्य च पशूनां च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: yajnayajniyasya cha vai sa vamadevyasya cha yajnasya cha yajamanasya cha pashunam cha priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: तस्य दक्षिणायां दिश्युषाः पुंश्चली मन्त्रो मागधो विज्ञानं वासोऽहरुष्णीषं रात्री केशा हरितौ प्रवर्तौ कल्मलिर्मणिः ॥
verses.rom: tasya dakshinayam dishyushah pumshchali mantro magadho vijnanam vaso'harushnisham ratri kesha haritau pravartau kalmalirmanih ||

verses.sa:
अमावास्या च पौर्णमासी च परिष्कन्दौ मनो विपथं मातरिश्वा च पवमानश्च विपथवाहौ वातः सारथी रेष्मा प्रतोदः
कीर्तिश्च यशश्च पुरःसरौ ।
ऐनं कीर्तिर्गच्छत्या यशो गच्छति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
amavasya cha paurnamasi cha parishkandau mano vipatham matarishva cha pavamanashcha vipathavahau vatah sarathi reshma pratodah
kirtishcha yashashcha purahsarau |
ainam kirtirgachchhatya yasho gachchhati ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: स उदतिष्ठत्स प्रतीचीं दिशमनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom: sa udatishthatsa pratichim dishamanu vyachalat ||

verses.sa: तं वैरूपं च वैराजं चापश्च वरुणश्च राजानुव्यचलन् ॥
verses.rom: tam vairupam cha vairajam chapashcha varunashcha rajanuvyachalan ||

verses.sa: वैरूपाय च वै स वैराजाय चाद्भ्यश्च वरुणाय च राज्ञ आ वृश्चते य एवं विद्वांसं व्रात्यमुपवदति ॥
verses.rom: vairupaya cha vai sa vairajaya chadbhyashcha varunaya cha rajna a vrishchate ya evam vidvamsam vratyamupavadati ||

verses.sa: वैरूपस्य च वै स वैराजस्य चापां च वरुणस्य च राज्ञः प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: vairupasya cha vai sa vairajasya chapam cha varunasya cha rajnah priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: तस्य प्रतीच्यां दिशीरा पुंश्चली हसो मागधो विज्ञानं वासोऽहरुष्णीषं रात्री केशा हरितौ प्रवर्तौ कल्मलिर्मणिः ॥
verses.rom: tasya pratichyam dishira pumshchali haso magadho vijnanam vaso'harushnisham ratri kesha haritau pravartau kalmalirmanih ||

verses.sa:
अहश्च रात्री च परिष्कन्दौ मनो विपथं मातरिश्वा च पवमानश्च विपथवाहौ वातः सारथी रेष्मा प्रतोदः
कीर्तिश्च यशश्च पुरःसरौ ।
ऐनं कीर्तिर्गच्छत्या यशो गच्छति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
ahashcha ratri cha parishkandau mano vipatham matarishva cha pavamanashcha vipathavahau vatah sarathi reshma pratodah
kirtishcha yashashcha purahsarau |
ainam kirtirgachchhatya yasho gachchhati ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: स उदतिष्ठत्स उदीचीं दिशमनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom: sa udatishthatsa udichim dishamanu vyachalat ||

verses.sa: तं श्यैतं च नौधसं च सप्तर्षयश्च सोमश्च राजानुव्यचलन् ॥
verses.rom: tam shyaitam cha naudhasam cha saptarshayashcha somashcha rajanuvyachalan ||

verses.sa: श्यैताय च वै स नौधसाय च सप्तर्षिभ्यश्च सोमाय च राज्ञ आ वृश्चते य एवं विद्वांसं व्रात्यमुपवदति ॥
verses.rom: shyaitaya cha vai sa naudhasaya cha saptarshibhyashcha somaya cha rajna a vrishchate ya evam vidvamsam vratyamupavadati ||

verses.sa: श्यैतस्य च वै स नौधसस्य च सप्तर्षीणां च सोमस्य च राज्ञः प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: shyaitasya cha vai sa naudhasasya cha saptarshinam cha somasya cha rajnah priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: तस्योदीच्यां दिशि विद्युत्पुंश्चली स्तनयित्नुर्मागधो विज्ञानं वासोऽहरुष्णीषं रात्री केशा हरितौ प्रवर्तौ कल्मलिर्मणिः ॥
verses.rom: tasyodichyam dishi vidyutpumshchali stanayitnurmagadho vijnanam vaso'harushnisham ratri kesha haritau pravartau kalmalirmanih ||

verses.sa: श्रुतं च विश्रुतं च परिष्कन्दौ मनो विपथं मातरिश्वा च पवमानश्च विपथवाहौ वातः सारथी रेष्मा प्रतोदः ॥
verses.rom: shrutam cha vishrutam cha parishkandau mano vipatham matarishva cha pavamanashcha vipathavahau vatah sarathi reshma pratodah ||

verses.sa: कीर्तिश्च यशश्च पुरःसरौ ॥
verses.rom: kirtishcha yashashcha purahsarau ||

verses.sa: ऐनं कीर्तिर्गच्छत्या यशो गच्छति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: ainam kirtirgachchhatya yasho gachchhati ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: स संवत्सरमूर्ध्वोऽतिष्ठत्तं देवा अब्रुवन् व्रात्य किं नु तिष्ठसीति ॥
verses.rom: sa samvatsaramurdhvo'tishthattam deva abruvan vratya kim nu tishthasiti ||
verses.en: He stood a year erect; the gods said to him: Vrātya, why now standest thou?

verses.sa: सोऽब्रवीदासन्दीं मे सं भरन्त्विति ॥
verses.rom: so'bravidasandim me sam bharantviti ||
verses.en: He said: Let them bring together a settle āsandī́ for me.

verses.sa: तस्मै व्रात्यायासन्दीं समभरन् ॥
verses.rom: tasmai vratyayasandim samabharan ||
verses.en: For that Vrātya they brought together a settle.

verses.sa: तस्या ग्रीष्मश्च वसन्तश्च द्वौ पादावास्तां शरच्च वर्षाश्च द्वौ ॥
verses.rom: tasya grishmashcha vasantashcha dvau padavastam sharachcha varshashcha dvau ||
verses.en: Of it, both summer and spring were two feet, both autumn and the rains [were] two.

verses.sa: बृहच्च रथन्तरं चानूच्ये आस्तां यज्ञायज्ञियं च वामदेव्यं च तिरश्च्ये ॥
verses.rom: brihachcha rathantaram chanuchye astam yajnayajniyam cha vamadevyam cha tirashchye ||
verses.en: Both bṛhát and rathaṁtará were the two length-wise [pieces], both yajñāyajñíya and vāmadevyá the two cross[-pieces].

verses.sa: ऋचः प्राञ्चस्तन्तवो यजूंषि तिर्यञ्चः ॥
verses.rom: richah pranchastantavo yajumshi tiryanchah ||
verses.en: The verses (ṛ́c) the forward cords (tántu), the sacrificial formulas (yájus) the cross ones.

verses.sa: वेद आस्तरणं ब्रह्मोपबर्हणम् ॥
verses.rom: veda astaranam brahmopabarhanam ||
verses.en: The Veda the cushion (āstáraṇa), the bráhman the pillow (upabárhaṇa).

verses.sa: सामासाद उद्गीथोऽपश्रयः ॥
verses.rom: samasada udgitho'pashrayah ||
verses.en: The chant (sā́man) the seat, the udgīthá the support (?).

verses.sa: तामासन्दीं व्रात्य आरोहत् ॥
verses.rom: tamasandim vratya arohat ||
verses.en: That settle the Vrātya ascended.

verses.sa: तस्य देवजनाः परिष्कन्दा आसन्त्संकल्पाः प्रहाय्या विश्वानि भूतान्युपसदः ॥
verses.rom: tasya devajanah parishkanda asantsamkalpah prahayya vishvani bhutanyupasadah ||
verses.en: Of him the god-folk were the footmen, resolves (saṁkalpá) the messengers (prahāyyà), all beings the waiters (upasád).

verses.sa: विश्वान्येवास्य भूतान्युपसदो भवन्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: vishvanyevasya bhutanyupasado bhavanti ya evam veda ||
verses.en: All beings become his waiters who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: तस्मै प्राच्या दिशः ॥
verses.rom: tasmai prachya dishah ||

verses.sa: वासन्तौ मासौ गोप्तारावकुर्वन् बृहच्च रथन्तरं चानुष्ठातारौ ॥
verses.rom: vasantau masau goptaravakurvan brihachcha rathantaram chanushthatarau ||

verses.sa:
वासन्तावेनं मासौ प्राच्या दिशो गोपायतो बृहच्च रथन्तरं चानु तिष्ठतो य एवं वेद॥
तस्मै दक्षिणाया दिशः ॥
verses.rom:
vasantavenam masau prachya disho gopayato brihachcha rathantaram chanu tishthato ya evam veda||
tasmai dakshinaya dishah ||

verses.sa:
ग्रैष्मौ मासौ गोप्तारावकुर्वन् यज्ञायज्ञियं च वामदेव्यं चानुष्ठातारौ ।
ग्रैष्मावेनं मासौ दक्षिणाया दिशो गोपायतो यज्ञायज्ञियं च वामदेव्यं चानु तिष्ठतो य एवं वेद॥
तस्मै प्रतीच्या दिशः ॥
verses.rom:
graishmau masau goptaravakurvan yajnayajniyam cha vamadevyam chanushthatarau |
graishmavenam masau dakshinaya disho gopayato yajnayajniyam cha vamadevyam chanu tishthato ya evam veda||
tasmai pratichya dishah ||

verses.sa: वार्षिकौ मासौ गोप्तारावकुर्वन् वैरूपं च वैराजं चानुष्ठातारौ ॥
verses.rom: varshikau masau goptaravakurvan vairupam cha vairajam chanushthatarau ||

verses.sa:
वार्षिकावेनं मासौ प्रतीच्या दिशो गोपायतो वैरूपं च वैराजं चानु तिष्ठतो य एवं वेद॥
तस्मा उदीच्या दिशः ॥
verses.rom:
varshikavenam masau pratichya disho gopayato vairupam cha vairajam chanu tishthato ya evam veda||
tasma udichya dishah ||

verses.sa: शारदौ मासौ गोप्तारावकुर्वं छ्यैतं च नौधसं चानुष्ठातारौ ॥
verses.rom: sharadau masau goptaravakurvam chhyaitam cha naudhasam chanushthatarau ||

verses.sa:
शारदावेनं मासावुदीच्या दिशो गोपायतः श्यैतं च नौधसं चानु तिष्ठतो य एवं वेद॥
तस्मै ध्रुवाया दिशः ॥
verses.rom:
sharadavenam masavudichya disho gopayatah shyaitam cha naudhasam chanu tishthato ya evam veda||
tasmai dhruvaya dishah ||

verses.sa: हैमनौ मासौ गोप्तारावकुर्वन् भूमिं चाग्निं चानुष्ठातारौ ॥
verses.rom: haimanau masau goptaravakurvan bhumim chagnim chanushthatarau ||

verses.sa:
हैमनावेनं मासौ ध्रुवाया दिशो गोपायतो भूमिश्चाग्निश्चानु तिष्ठतो य एवं वेद॥
तस्मा ऊर्ध्वाया दिशः ॥
verses.rom:
haimanavenam masau dhruvaya disho gopayato bhumishchagnishchanu tishthato ya evam veda||
tasma urdhvaya dishah ||

verses.sa: शैशिरौ मासौ गोप्तारावकुर्वन् दिवं चादित्यं चानुष्ठातारौ ॥
verses.rom: shaishirau masau goptaravakurvan divam chadityam chanushthatarau ||

prose.en:
1. 1. For him, from the eastern quarter, 2. they made the two spring months guardians, and bṛhát and rathaṁtará attendants. 3. The two spring months guard from the eastern quarter, and bṛhát and rathaṁtará attend (anu-sthā), him who knoweth thus.

2. 4. For him, from the southern quarter, 5. they made the two summer months guardians, and yajñāyajñíya and vāmadevyá attendants. 6. The two summer months guard from the southern quarter, and yajñājñíya and vāmadevyá attend, him who knoweth thus.

3. 7. For him, from the western quarter, 8. they made the two rainy months guardians, and vāirūpá and vāirājá attendants. 9. The

4. 10. For him, from the northern quarter, 11. they made the two autumn months guardians, and çyāitá and nāudhasá attendants. 12. The two autumn months guard from the northern quarter, and çyāitá and nāudhasá attend, him who knoweth thus.

5. 13. For him, from the fixed quarter, 14. they made the two winter months guardians, and earth and fire attendants. 15. The two winter months guard from the fixed quarter, and earth and fire attend, him who knoweth thus.

6. 16. For him, from the upward quarter, 17. they made the two cool months guardians, and heaven and Āditya attendants. 18. The two cool months guard from the upward quarter, and heaven and Āditya attend, him who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: तस्मै प्राच्या दिशो अन्तर्देशाद्भवमिष्वासमनुष्ठातारमकुर्वन् ॥
verses.rom: tasmai prachya disho antardeshadbhavamishvasamanushthataramakurvan ||

verses.sa:
भव एनमिष्वासः प्राच्या दिशो अन्तर्देशादनुष्ठातानु तिष्ठति नैनं शर्वो न भवो नेशानः॥
नास्य पशून् न समानान् हिनस्ति य एवं वेद॥
तस्मै दक्षिणाया दिशो अन्तर्देशाच्छर्वमिष्वासमनुष्ठातारमकुर्वन् ॥
verses.rom:
bhava enamishvasah prachya disho antardeshadanushthatanu tishthati nainam sharvo na bhavo neshanah||
nasya pashun na samanan hinasti ya evam veda||
tasmai dakshinaya disho antardeshachchharvamishvasamanushthataramakurvan ||

verses.sa:
शर्व एनमिश्वासो दक्षिणाया दिशो अन्तर्देशादनुष्ठातानु तिष्ठति नैनं शर्वो न भवो नेशानः॥
नास्य पशून् न समानान् हिनस्ति य एवं वेद॥
तस्मै प्रतीच्या दिशो अन्तर्देशात्पशुपतिमिष्वासमनुष्ठातारमकुर्वन् ॥
verses.rom:
sharva enamishvaso dakshinaya disho antardeshadanushthatanu tishthati nainam sharvo na bhavo neshanah||
nasya pashun na samanan hinasti ya evam veda||
tasmai pratichya disho antardeshatpashupatimishvasamanushthataramakurvan ||

verses.sa:
पशुपतिरेनमिष्वासः प्रतीच्या दिशो अन्तर्देशादनुष्ठातानु तिष्ठति नैनं शर्वो न भवो नेशानः॥
नास्य पशून् न समानान् हिनस्ति य एवं वेद॥
तस्मा उदीच्या दिशो अन्तर्देशादुग्रं देवमिष्वासमनुष्ठातारमकुर्वन् ॥
verses.rom:
pashupatirenamishvasah pratichya disho antardeshadanushthatanu tishthati nainam sharvo na bhavo neshanah||
nasya pashun na samanan hinasti ya evam veda||
tasma udichya disho antardeshadugram devamishvasamanushthataramakurvan ||

verses.sa:
उग्र एनं देव इष्वास उदीच्या दिशो अन्तर्देशादनुष्ठातानु तिष्ठति नैनं शर्वो न भवो नेशानः॥
नास्य पशून् न समानान् हिनस्ति य एवं वेद॥
तस्मै ध्रुवाया दिशो अन्तर्देशाद्रुद्रमिष्वासमनुष्ठातारमकुर्वन् ॥
verses.rom:
ugra enam deva ishvasa udichya disho antardeshadanushthatanu tishthati nainam sharvo na bhavo neshanah||
nasya pashun na samanan hinasti ya evam veda||
tasmai dhruvaya disho antardeshadrudramishvasamanushthataramakurvan ||

verses.sa:
रुद्र एनमिष्वासो ध्रुवाया दिशो अन्तर्देशादनुष्ठातानु तिष्ठति नैनं शर्वो न भवो नेशानः॥
नास्य पशून् न समानान् हिनस्ति य एवं वेद॥
तस्मा ऊर्ध्वाया दिशो अन्तर्देशान् महादेवमिष्वासमनुष्ठातारमकुर्वन् । [१२
महादेव एनमिष्वास ऊर्ध्वाया दिशो अन्तर्देशादनुष्ठातानु तिष्ठति नैनं शर्वो न भवो नेशानः॥
नास्य पशून् न समानान् हिनस्ति य एवं वेद॥
तस्मै सर्वेभ्यो अन्तर्देशेभ्य ईशानमिष्वासमनुष्ठातारमकुर्वन् ॥
verses.rom:
rudra enamishvaso dhruvaya disho antardeshadanushthatanu tishthati nainam sharvo na bhavo neshanah||
nasya pashun na samanan hinasti ya evam veda||
tasma urdhvaya disho antardeshan mahadevamishvasamanushthataramakurvan | [12
mahadeva enamishvasa urdhvaya disho antardeshadanushthatanu tishthati nainam sharvo na bhavo neshanah||
nasya pashun na samanan hinasti ya evam veda||
tasmai sarvebhyo antardeshebhya ishanamishvasamanushthataramakurvan ||

prose.en:
1. 1. For him, from the intermediate direction of the eastern quarter, they made the archer (iṣvāsá) Bhava attendant. 2. The archer Bhava attends him [as] attendant from the intermediate direction of the eastern quarter; not Çarva, not Bhava, not Īçāna ('the lord') 3. injures him nor his cattle nor his fellows who knoweth thus.

2. 4. For him, from the intermediate direction of the southern quarter, they made the archer Çarva attendant. 5. The archer Çarva attends him as attendant from the intermediate direction of the southern quarter; not Çarva etc. etc.

3. 6. For him, from the intermediate direction of the western quarter, they made the archer Paçupati ('lord of cattle') attendant. 7. The archer Paçupati attends him as attendant from the intermediate direction of the western quarter; not Çarva etc. etc.

4. 8. For him, from the intermediate direction of the northern quarter, they made the archer, the formidable god, attendant. 9. The archer, the formidable god, attends him as attendant from the intermediate direction of the northern quarter; not Çarva etc. etc.

5. 10. For him, from the intermediate direction of the fixed quarter, they made the archer Rudra attendant. 11. The archer Rudra attends him as attendant from the intermediate direction of the fixed quarter; not Çarva etc. etc.

6. 12. For him, from the intermediate direction of the upward quarter, they made the archer Mahādeva ('great god') attendant. 13. The archer Mahādeva attends him as attendant from the intermediate direction of the upward quarter; not Çarva etc. etc.

7. 14. For him, from all the intermediate directions, they made the archer Īçāna attendant. 15. The archer Īçāna as attendant attends him from all the intermediate directions; not Çarva, not Bhava, not Īçāna, 16. injures him nor his cattle nor his fellows who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: स ध्रुवां दिशमनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom: sa dhruvam dishamanu vyachalat ||

verses.sa:
तं भूमिश्चाग्निश्चौषधयश्च वनस्पतयश्च वानस्पत्याश्च वीरुधश्चानुव्यचलन् ।
भूमेश्च वै सोऽग्नेश्चौषधीनां च वनस्पतीनां च वानस्पत्यानां च वीरुधां च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद
स ऊर्ध्वां दिशमनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom:
tam bhumishchagnishchaushadhayashcha vanaspatayashcha vanaspatyashcha virudhashchanuvyachalan |
bhumeshcha vai so'gneshchaushadhinam cha vanaspatinam cha vanaspatyanam cha virudham cha priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda
sa urdhvam dishamanu vyachalat ||

verses.sa: तमृतं च सत्यं च सूर्यश्च चन्द्रश्च नक्षत्राणि चानुव्यचलन् ॥
verses.rom: tamritam cha satyam cha suryashcha chandrashcha nakshatrani chanuvyachalan ||

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य च वै स सत्यस्य च सूर्यस्य च चन्द्रस्य च नक्षत्राणां च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद
स उत्तमां दिशमनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya cha vai sa satyasya cha suryasya cha chandrasya cha nakshatranam cha priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda
sa uttamam dishamanu vyachalat ||

verses.sa: तमृचश्च सामानि च यजूंषि च ब्रह्म चानुव्यचलन् ॥
verses.rom: tamrichashcha samani cha yajumshi cha brahma chanuvyachalan ||

verses.sa: ऋचां च वै स साम्नां च यजुषां च ब्रह्मणश्च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: richam cha vai sa samnam cha yajusham cha brahmanashcha priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: स बृहतीं दिशमनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom: sa brihatim dishamanu vyachalat ||

verses.sa: तमितिहासश्च पुराणं च गाथाश्च नाराशंसीश्चानुव्यचलन् ॥
verses.rom: tamitihasashcha puranam cha gathashcha narashamsishchanuvyachalan ||

verses.sa:
इतिहासस्य च वै स पुराणस्य च गाथानां च नाराशंसीनां च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद॥
स परमां दिशमनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom:
itihasasya cha vai sa puranasya cha gathanam cha narashamsinam cha priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda||
sa paramam dishamanu vyachalat ||

verses.sa:
तमाहवनीयश्च गार्हपत्यश्च दक्षिणाग्निश्च यज्ञश्च यजमानश्च पशवश्चानुव्यचलन्॥
आहवनीयस्य च वै स गार्हपत्यस्य च दक्षिणाग्नेश्च यज्ञस्य च यजमानस्य च पशूनां च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद
सोऽनादिष्टां दिशमनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom:
tamahavaniyashcha garhapatyashcha dakshinagnishcha yajnashcha yajamanashcha pashavashchanuvyachalan||
ahavaniyasya cha vai sa garhapatyasya cha dakshinagneshcha yajnasya cha yajamanasya cha pashunam cha priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda
so'nadishtam dishamanu vyachalat ||

verses.sa:
तमृतवश्चार्तवाश्च लोकाश्च लौक्याश्च मासाश्चार्धमासाश्चाहोरात्रे चानुव्यचलन्॥
ऋतूनां च वै स आर्तवानां च लोकानां च लौक्यानां च मासानां चार्धमासानां चाहोरात्रयोश्च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद
सोऽनावृत्तां दिशमनु व्यचलत्ततो नावर्त्स्यन्न् अमन्यत ॥
verses.rom:
tamritavashchartavashcha lokashcha laukyashcha masashchardhamasashchahoratre chanuvyachalan||
ritunam cha vai sa artavanam cha lokanam cha laukyanam cha masanam chardhamasanam chahoratrayoshcha priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda
so'navrittam dishamanu vyachalattato navartsyann amanyata ||

verses.sa: तं दितिश्चादितिश्चेडा चेन्द्राणी चानुव्यचलन् ॥
verses.rom: tam ditishchaditishcheda chendrani chanuvyachalan ||

verses.sa:
दितेश्च वै सोऽदितेश्चेडायाश्चेन्द्राण्याश्च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद
स दिशोऽनु व्यचलत्तं विराडनु व्यचलत्सर्वे च देवाः सर्वाश्च देवताः ॥
verses.rom:
diteshcha vai so'diteshchedayashchendranyashcha priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda
sa disho'nu vyachalattam viradanu vyachalatsarve cha devah sarvashcha devatah ||

verses.sa:
विराजश्च वै स सर्वेषां च देवानां सर्वासां च देवतानां प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद॥
स सर्वान् अन्तर्देशान् अनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom:
virajashcha vai sa sarvesham cha devanam sarvasam cha devatanam priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda||
sa sarvan antardeshan anu vyachalat ||

verses.sa: तं प्रजापतिश्च परमेष्ठी च पिता च पितामहश्चानुव्यचलन् ॥
verses.rom: tam prajapatishcha parameshthi cha pita cha pitamahashchanuvyachalan ||

prose.en:
1. 1. He moved out toward the fixed quarter; 2. after him moved out both earth and fire and herbs and forest trees and they of forest trees and plants. 3. Verily both of earth and of fire and of herbs and of forest trees and of them of forest trees and of plants doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

2. 4. He moved out toward the upward quarter; 5. after him moved out both right and truth and sun and moon and asterisms. 6. Verily both of right and of truth and of sun and of moon and of asterisms doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

3. 7. He moved out toward the highest quarter; 8. after him moved out both the verses and the chants and the sacrificial formulas and the bráhman. 9. Verily both of the verses and of the chants and of the sacrificial formulas and of the bráhman doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

4. 10. He moved out toward the great quarter; 11. after him moved out both the itihāsá ('narrative') and the purāṇá ('story of eld') and the gā́thās ('songs') and the nārāçansī́s ('eulogies'). 12. Verily both of the itihāsá and of the purāṇá and of the gā́thās and of the nārāçansī́s doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

5. 13. He moved out toward the most distant quarter; 14. after him moved out both the fire of offering and the householder's fire and the southern fire and the sacrifice and the sacrificer and the cattle. 15. Verily both of the fire of offering and of the householder's fire and of the southern fire and of the sacrifice and of the sacrificer and of the cattle doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

6. 16. He moved out toward an unindicated quarter; 17. after him moved out both the seasons and they of the seasons and the worlds and they of the worlds and the months and the half-months and day-and-night. 18. Verily both of the seasons and of them of the seasons and of the worlds and of them of the worlds and of the months and of the half-months and of day-and-night doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

7. 19. He moved out toward an unreturned quarter; from it he thought not that he should return; 20. after him moved out both Diti and Aditi and Iḍā and Indrāṇī. 21. Verily both of Diti and of Aditi and of Iḍā and of Indrāṇī doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

8. 22. He moved out toward the quarters; no avasāna! after him moved out the virā́j and all the gods and all the deities. 23. Verily both of virā́j and of all the gods and of all the deities doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

9. 24. He moved out toward all the intermediate directions; 25. after him moved out both Prajāpati and the most exalted one and the father and the grandfather. 26. Verily both of Prajāpati and of the most exalted one and of the father and of the grandfather doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: स महिमा सद्रुर्भूत्वान्तं पृथिव्या अगच्छत्समुद्रोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom: sa mahima sadrurbhutvantam prithivya agachchhatsamudro'bhavat ||

verses.sa: तं प्रजापतिश्च परमेष्ठी च पिता च पितामहश्चापश्च श्रद्धा च वर्षं भूत्वानुव्यवर्तयन्त ॥
verses.rom: tam prajapatishcha parameshthi cha pita cha pitamahashchapashcha shraddha cha varsham bhutvanuvyavartayanta ||

verses.sa: ऐनमापो गच्छन्त्यैनं श्रद्धा गच्छत्यैनं वर्षं गच्छति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: ainamapo gachchhantyainam shraddha gachchhatyainam varsham gachchhati ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: तं श्रद्धा च यज्ञश्च लोकश्चान्नं चान्नाद्यं च भूत्वाभिपर्यावर्तन्त ॥
verses.rom: tam shraddha cha yajnashcha lokashchannam channadyam cha bhutvabhiparyavartanta ||

prose.en:
1. That greatness, becoming sessile (? sádru), went to the end of the earth; it became ocean.

2. After it, turned out both Prajāpati and the most exalted one and the father and the grandfather and the waters and faith, becoming rain.

3. To him come waters, to him cometh faith, to him cometh rain, who knoweth thus.

4. Unto it turned about both faith and sacrifice and world and food and food-eating, coming into being (bhūtvā́).

5. To him cometh faith, to him cometh sacrifice, to him cometh a world, to him cometh food, to him cometh food-eating, who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: सोऽरज्यत ततो राजन्योऽजायत ॥
verses.rom: so'rajyata tato rajanyo'jayata ||
verses.en: He became impassioned (raj); thence was born the noble (rājanyà).

verses.sa: स विशः सबन्धून् अन्नमन्नाद्यमभ्युदतिष्ठत् ॥
verses.rom: sa vishah sabandhun annamannadyamabhyudatishthat ||
verses.en: He arose toward (abhi॰) the tribes (víç), the kinsmen, food, food-eating.

verses.sa: विशां च वै स सबन्धूनां चान्नस्य चान्नाद्यस्य च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: visham cha vai sa sabandhunam channasya channadyasya cha priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: Verily both of the tribes and of the kinsmen and of food and of food-eating doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: स विशोऽनु व्यचलत् ॥
verses.rom: sa visho'nu vyachalat ||
verses.en: He moved out toward the tribes.

verses.sa: तं सभा च समितिश्च सेना च सुरा चानुव्यचलन् ॥
verses.rom: tam sabha cha samitishcha sena cha sura chanuvyachalan ||
verses.en: After him moved out both the assembly and the gathering and the army and strong drink.

verses.sa: सभायाश्च वै स समितेश्च सेनायाश्च सुरायाश्च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: sabhayashcha vai sa samiteshcha senayashcha surayashcha priyam dhama bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: Verily both of the assembly and of the gathering and of the army and of strong drink doth he become the dear abode who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: तद्यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्यो राज्ञोऽतिथिर्गृहान् आगच्छेत् ॥
verses.rom: tadyasyaivam vidvan vratyo rajno'tithirgrihan agachchhet ||

verses.sa:
श्रेयांसमेनमात्मनो मानयेत्तथा क्षत्राय ना वृश्चते तथा राष्ट्राय ना वृश्चते ॥
अतो वै ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं चोदतिष्ठतां ते अब्रूतां कं प्र विशावेति ॥
verses.rom:
shreyamsamenamatmano manayettatha kshatraya na vrishchate tatha rashtraya na vrishchate ||
ato vai brahma cha kshatram chodatishthatam te abrutam kam pra vishaveti ||

verses.sa: बृहस्पतिमेव ब्रह्म प्रविशत्विन्द्रं क्षत्रं तथा वा इति ॥
verses.rom: brihaspatimeva brahma pravishatvindram kshatram tatha va iti ||

verses.sa: अतो वै बृहस्पतिमेव ब्रह्म प्राविशदिन्द्रं क्षत्रम् ॥
verses.rom: ato vai brihaspatimeva brahma pravishadindram kshatram ||

verses.sa: इयं वा उ पृथिवी बृहस्पतिर्द्यौरेवेन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom: iyam va u prithivi brihaspatirdyaurevendrah ||

verses.sa: अयं वा उ अग्निर्ब्रह्मासावादित्यः क्षत्रम् ॥
verses.rom: ayam va u agnirbrahmasavadityah kshatram ||

verses.sa: ऐनं ब्रह्म गच्छति ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति ॥
verses.rom: ainam brahma gachchhati brahmavarchasi bhavati ||

verses.sa: यः पृथिवीं बृहस्पतिमग्निं ब्रह्म वेद ॥
verses.rom: yah prithivim brihaspatimagnim brahma veda ||

verses.sa: ऐनमिन्द्रियं गच्छतीन्द्रियवान् भवति ॥
verses.rom: ainamindriyam gachchhatindriyavan bhavati ||

verses.sa: य आदित्यं क्षत्रं दिवमिन्द्रं वेद ॥
verses.rom: ya adityam kshatram divamindram veda ||

prose.en:
1. So then, to the houses of whatever king a thus-knowing Vrātya may come as guest,—

2. He should esteem him better than himself; so does he not offend (ā-vraçc) against dominion; so does he not offend against royalty.

3. Thence verily arose both sanctity (bráhman) and dominion; they said: Whom shall we enter?

4. Let sanctity enter Brihaspati [and] dominion Indra; thus verily: it was said (íti).

5. Thence (átas) verily sanctity entered Brihaspati [and] dominion Indra.

6. This earth verily is Prajāpati, the sky is Indra.

7. This fire verily is sanctity, yonder Āditya is dominion.

8. To him comes sanctity, he becomes possessed of the splendor of sanctity (brahmavarcasín),—

9. Who knows earth as Brihaspati, fire as sanctity.

10. To him comes Indra's quality, he becomes possessed of Indra's quality,—

11. Who knows Āditya as dominion, the sky as Indra.

verses.sa: तद्यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्योऽतिथिर्गृहान् आगच्छेत् ॥
verses.rom: tadyasyaivam vidvan vratyo'tithirgrihan agachchhet ||
verses.en: So then, to whosesoever houses a thus-knowing Vrātya may come as guest,—

verses.sa: स्वयमेनमभ्युदेत्य ब्रूयाद्व्रात्य क्वावात्सीर्व्रात्योदकं व्रात्य तर्पयन्तु व्रात्य यथा ते प्रियं तथास्तु व्रात्य यथा ते वशस्तथास्तु व्रात्य यथा ते निकामस्तथास्त्विति ॥
verses.rom: svayamenamabhyudetya bruyadvratya kvavatsirvratyodakam vratya tarpayantu vratya yatha te priyam tathastu vratya yatha te vashastathastu vratya yatha te nikamastathastviti ||
verses.en: Himself coming up toward him, he should say: Vrātya, where hast thou abode (vas)? Vrātya, [here is] water; Vrātya, let them gratify [thee]; Vrātya, be it so as is dear to thee; Vrātya, be it so as is thy will (váça); Vrātya, be it so as is thy desire (nikāmá).

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्य क्वावात्सीरिति पथ एव तेन देवयानान् अव रुन्धे ॥
verses.rom: yadenamaha vratya kvavatsiriti patha eva tena devayanan ava rundhe ||
verses.en: In that he says to him: Vrātya, where hast thou abode? he thereby gains possession of the roads that the gods travel.

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्योदकमित्यप एव तेनाव रुन्धे ॥
verses.rom: yadenamaha vratyodakamityapa eva tenava rundhe ||
verses.en: In that he says to him: Vrātya, [here is] water, he thereby gains possession of the waters.

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्य तर्पयन्त्विति प्राणमेव तेन वर्षीयांसं कुरुते ॥
verses.rom: yadenamaha vratya tarpayantviti pranameva tena varshiyamsam kurute ||
verses.en: In that he says to him: Vrātya, let them gratify [thee], he thereby makes his breath (prāṇá) longer.

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्य यथा ते प्रियं तथास्त्विति प्रियमेव तेनाव रुन्धे ॥
verses.rom: yadenamaha vratya yatha te priyam tathastviti priyameva tenava rundhe ||
verses.en: In that he says to him: Vrātya, be it so as is dear to thee, he thereby gains possession of what is dear.

verses.sa: ऐनं प्रियं गच्छति प्रियः प्रियस्य भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: ainam priyam gachchhati priyah priyasya bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: To him cometh what is dear, he becometh dear to his dear one (m.), who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्य यथा ते वशस्तथास्त्विति वशमेव तेनाव रुन्धे ॥
verses.rom: yadenamaha vratya yatha te vashastathastviti vashameva tenava rundhe ||
verses.en: In that he says to him: Vrātya, be it so as is thy will, he thereby gains possession of [his] will.

verses.sa: ऐनं वशो गच्छति वशी वशिनां भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: ainam vasho gachchhati vashi vashinam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: Unto him cometh [his] will, a will-possessor of will-possessors becometh he who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्य यथा ते निकामस्तथास्त्विति निकाममेव तेनाव रुन्धे ॥
verses.rom: yadenamaha vratya yatha te nikamastathastviti nikamameva tenava rundhe ||
verses.en: In that he says to him: Vrātya, be it so as is thy desire, he thereby gains possession of [his] desire.

verses.sa: ऐनं निकामो गच्छति निकामे निकामस्य भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: ainam nikamo gachchhati nikame nikamasya bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: To him cometh [his] desire, he cometh to be (bhū) in the desire of desire, who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: तद्यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्य उद्धृतेष्वग्निष्वधिश्रितेऽग्निहोत्रेऽतिथिर्गृहान् आगच्छेत् ॥
verses.rom: tadyasyaivam vidvan vratya uddhriteshvagnishvadhishrite'gnihotre'tithirgrihan agachchhet ||
verses.en: Now then, to whosesoever houses a thus-knowing Vrātya may come as guest when the fires are taken up and the fire-offering (agnihotrá) set on,—

verses.sa: स्वयमेनमभ्युदेत्य ब्रूयाद्व्रात्याति सृज होष्यामीति ॥
verses.rom: svayamenamabhyudetya bruyadvratyati srija hoshyamiti ||
verses.en: Himself coming up toward him, he should say: Vrātya, give permission; I am about to make oblation.

verses.sa: स चातिसृजेज्जुहुयान् न चातिसृजेन् न जुहुयात् ॥
verses.rom: sa chatisrijejjuhuyan na chatisrijen na juhuyat ||
verses.en: If he should permit, he may make oblation; if he should not permit, he may not make oblation.

verses.sa: स य एवं विदुषा व्रात्येनातिसृष्टो जुहोति ॥
verses.rom: sa ya evam vidusha vratyenatisrishto juhoti ||
verses.en: He who, being permitted by a thus-knowing Vrātya, makes oblation,—

verses.sa: प्र पितृयाणं पन्थां जानाति प्र देवयानम् ॥
verses.rom: pra pitriyanam pantham janati pra devayanam ||
verses.en: He foreknows the road that the Fathers go, the road that the gods go.

verses.sa: न देवेष्वा वृश्चते हुतमस्य भवति ॥
verses.rom: na deveshva vrishchate hutamasya bhavati ||
verses.en: He does not offend against the gods; his oblation is [duly] made.

verses.sa: पर्यस्यास्मिंल्लोक आयतनं शिष्यते य एवं विदुषा व्रात्येनातिसृष्टो जुहोति ॥
verses.rom: paryasyasmimlloka ayatanam shishyate ya evam vidusha vratyenatisrishto juhoti ||
verses.en: There is left over in this world a support (āyátana) for him who, being permitted by a thus-knowing Vrātya, makes oblation.

verses.sa: अथ य एवं विदुषा व्रात्येनानतिसृष्टो जुहोति ॥
verses.rom: atha ya evam vidusha vratyenanatisrishto juhoti ||
verses.en: Now then, he who, being unpermitted by a thus-knowing Vrātya, makes oblation,—

verses.sa: न पितृयाणं पन्थां जानाति न देवयानम् ॥
verses.rom: na pitriyanam pantham janati na devayanam ||
verses.en: He knows not the road that the Fathers go, nor the road that the gods go.

verses.sa: आ देवेषु वृश्चते अहुतमस्य भवति ॥
verses.rom: a deveshu vrishchate ahutamasya bhavati ||
verses.en: He offends against the gods; his oblation is not [duly] made.

verses.sa: नास्यास्मिंल्लोक आयतनं शिष्यते य एवं विदुषा व्रात्येनानतिसृष्टो जुहोति ॥
verses.rom: nasyasmimlloka ayatanam shishyate ya evam vidusha vratyenanatisrishto juhoti ||
verses.en: There is left in this world no support for him who, being unpermitted by a thus-knowing Vrātya, makes oblation.

verses.sa:
तद्यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्य एकां रात्रिमतिथिर्गृहे वसति ॥
ये पृथिव्यां पुण्या लोकास्तान् एव तेनाव रुन्धे ॥
verses.rom:
tadyasyaivam vidvan vratya ekam ratrimatithirgrihe vasati ||
ye prithivyam punya lokastan eva tenava rundhe ||

verses.sa: तद्यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्यो द्वितीयां रात्रिमतिथिर्गृहे वसति ॥
verses.rom: tadyasyaivam vidvan vratyo dvitiyam ratrimatithirgrihe vasati ||

verses.sa: येऽन्तरिक्षे पुण्या लोकास्तान् एव तेनाव रुन्धे ॥
verses.rom: ye'ntarikshe punya lokastan eva tenava rundhe ||

verses.sa: तद्यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्यस्तृतीयां रात्रिमतिथिर्गृहे वसति ॥
verses.rom: tadyasyaivam vidvan vratyastritiyam ratrimatithirgrihe vasati ||

verses.sa: ये दिवि पुण्या लोकास्तान् एव तेनाव रुन्धे ॥
verses.rom: ye divi punya lokastan eva tenava rundhe ||

verses.sa: तद्यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्यश्चतुर्थीं रात्रिमतिथिर्गृहे वसति ॥
verses.rom: tadyasyaivam vidvan vratyashchaturthim ratrimatithirgrihe vasati ||

verses.sa: ये पुण्यानां पुण्या लोकास्तान् एव तेनाव रुन्धे ॥
verses.rom: ye punyanam punya lokastan eva tenava rundhe ||

verses.sa: तद्यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्योऽपरिमिता रात्रीरतिथिर्गृहे वसति ॥
verses.rom: tadyasyaivam vidvan vratyo'parimita ratriratithirgrihe vasati ||

verses.sa: य एवापरिमिताः पुण्या लोकास्तान् एव तेनाव रुन्धे ॥
verses.rom: ya evaparimitah punya lokastan eva tenava rundhe ||

verses.sa: अथ यस्याव्रात्यो व्रात्यब्रुवो नामबिभ्रत्यतिथिर्गृहान् आगछेत् ॥
verses.rom: atha yasyavratyo vratyabruvo namabibhratyatithirgrihan agachhet ||

verses.sa: कर्षेदेनं न चैनं कर्षेत् ॥
verses.rom: karshedenam na chainam karshet ||

verses.sa: अस्यै देवताया उदकं याचामीमां देवतां वासय इमामिमां देवतां परि वेवेष्मी परि वेविष्यात् ॥
verses.rom: asyai devataya udakam yachamimam devatam vasaya imamimam devatam pari veveshmi pari vevishyat ||

verses.sa: तस्यामेवास्य तद्देवतायां हुतं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: tasyamevasya taddevatayam hutam bhavati ya evam veda ||

prose.en:
1. 1. Now in whosesoever house a thus-knowing Vrātya abides one night as guest, 2. he thereby gains possession of those pure (púṇya) worlds that are on the earth.

2. 3. Now in whosesoever house a thus-knowing Vrātya abides a second night as guest, 4. he thereby gains possession of those pure worlds that are in the atmosphere.

3. 5. Now in whosesoever house a thus-knowing Vrātya abides a third night as guest, 6. he thereby gains possession of those pure worlds that are in the sky.

4. 7. Now in whosesoever house a thus-knowing Vrātya abides a fourth night as guest, 8. he thereby gains possession of those worlds that are pure of the pure.

5. 9. Now in whosesoever house a thus-knowing Vrātya abides unlimited nights as guest, 10. he thereby gains possession of those pure worlds that are unlimited.

6. 11. Now to whosesoever houses may come as guest a non-Vrātya, calling himself a Vrātya, bearing the name [only],—

7. 12. He may draw him, and he may not draw him.

8. 13. For this deity I ask water; this deity I cause to abide; this, this deity I wait upon—with this thought he should wait upon him.

9. 14. that deity doth that become [duly] offered of him who knoweth thus.

verses.sa:
स यत्प्राचीं दिशमनु व्यचलन् मारुतं शर्धो भूत्वानुव्यचलन् मनोऽन्नादं कृत्वा ॥
मनसान्नादेनान्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
sa yatprachim dishamanu vyachalan marutam shardho bhutvanuvyachalan mano'nnadam kritva ||
manasannadenannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa:
स यद्दक्षिणां दिशमनु व्यचलदिन्द्रो भूत्वानुव्यचलद्बलमन्नादं कृत्वा । [३
बलेनान्नादेनान्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
sa yaddakshinam dishamanu vyachaladindro bhutvanuvyachaladbalamannadam kritva | [3
balenannadenannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: स यत्प्रतीचीं दिशमनु व्यचलद्वरुणो राजा भूत्वानुव्यचलदपोऽन्नादीः कृत्वा ॥
verses.rom: sa yatpratichim dishamanu vyachaladvaruno raja bhutvanuvyachaladapo'nnadih kritva ||

verses.sa: अद्भिरन्नादीभिरन्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: adbhirannadibhirannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: स यदुदीचीं दिशमनु व्यचलत्सोमो राजा भूत्वानुव्यचलत्सप्तर्षिभिर्हुत आहुतिमन्नादीं कृत्वा ॥
verses.rom: sa yadudichim dishamanu vyachalatsomo raja bhutvanuvyachalatsaptarshibhirhuta ahutimannadim kritva ||

verses.sa: आहुत्यान्नाद्यान्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: ahutyannadyannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa:
स यद्ध्रुवां दिशमनु व्यचलद्विष्णुर्भूत्वानुव्यचलद्विराजमन्नादीं कृत्वा
विराजान्नाद्यान्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
sa yaddhruvam dishamanu vyachaladvishnurbhutvanuvyachaladvirajamannadim kritva
virajannadyannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: स यत्पशून् अनु व्यचलद्रुद्रो भूत्वानुव्यचलदोषधीरन्नादीः कृत्वा ॥
verses.rom: sa yatpashun anu vyachaladrudro bhutvanuvyachaladoshadhirannadih kritva ||

verses.sa: ओषधीभिरन्नादीभिरन्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: oshadhibhirannadibhirannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa:
स यत्पितॄन् अनु व्यचलद्यमो राजा भूत्वानुव्यचलत्स्वधाकारमन्नादं कृत्वा
स्वधाकारेणान्नादेनान्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
sa yatpitrin anu vyachaladyamo raja bhutvanuvyachalatsvadhakaramannadam kritva
svadhakarenannadenannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa:
स यन् मनुष्यान् अनु व्यचलदग्निर्भूत्वानुव्यचलत्स्वाहाकारमन्नादं कृत्वा
स्वाहाकारेणान्नादेनान्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
sa yan manushyan anu vyachaladagnirbhutvanuvyachalatsvahakaramannadam kritva
svahakarenannadenannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa:
स यदूर्ध्वां दिशमनु व्यचलद्बृहस्पतिर्भूत्वानुव्यचलद्वषट्कारमन्नादं कृत्वा
वषट्कारेणान्नादेनान्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
sa yadurdhvam dishamanu vyachaladbrihaspatirbhutvanuvyachaladvashatkaramannadam kritva
vashatkarenannadenannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa:
स यद्देवान् अनु व्यचलदीशानो भूत्वानुव्यचलन् मन्युमन्नादं कृत्वा । [१
मन्युनान्नादेनान्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
sa yaddevan anu vyachaladishano bhutvanuvyachalan manyumannadam kritva | [1
manyunannadenannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa:
स यत्प्रजा अनु व्यचलत्प्रजापतिर्भूत्वानुव्यचलत्प्राणमन्नादं कृत्वा ।
प्राणेनान्नादेनान्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
sa yatpraja anu vyachalatprajapatirbhutvanuvyachalatpranamannadam kritva |
pranenannadenannamatti ya evam veda ||

verses.sa: स यत्सर्वान् अन्तर्देशान् अनु व्यचलत्परमेष्ठी भूत्वानुव्यचलद्ब्रह्मान्नादं कृत्वा ॥
verses.rom: sa yatsarvan antardeshan anu vyachalatparameshthi bhutvanuvyachaladbrahmannadam kritva ||

verses.sa: ब्रह्मणान्नादेनान्नमत्ति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: brahmanannadenannamatti ya evam veda ||

prose.en:
1. 1. As he moved out toward the eastern quarter, the troop (çárdhas) of Maruts, coming into being (bhūtvā́), moved out after, making mind [their] food-eater; 2. with mind as food-eater doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

2. 3. As he moved out toward the southern quarter, Indra, coming into being, moved out after, making strength [his] food-eater; 4. with strength as food-eater doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

3. 5. As he moved out toward the western quarter, king Varuṇa, coming into being, moved out after, making the waters [his] food-eaters; 6. with the waters as food-eaters doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

4. 7. As he moved out toward the northern quarter, king Soma, coming into being, moved out after, making the offering (ā́huti) in what is offered by the seven seers [his] food-eater; 8. with the offering as food-eater doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

5. 9. he moved out toward the fixed quarter, Vishṇu, coming into being, moved out after, making virā́j [his] food-eater; 10. with virā́j as food-eater doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

6. 11. As he moved out toward the cattle, Rudra, coming into being, moved out after, making the herbs [his] food-eaters; 12. with the herbs as food-eaters doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

7. 13. As he moved out toward the Fathers, king Yama, coming into being, moved out after, making the call svadhā́ [his] food-eater; 14. with the call svadhā́ as food-eater doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

9. 17. As he moved out toward the upward quarter, Brihaspati, coming into being, moved out after, making the cry váṣaṭ [his] food-eater; 18. with the cry váṣaṭ as food-eater doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

10. 19. As he moved out toward the gods, Īçāna ('the lord'), coming into being, moved out after, making fury [his] food-eater; 20. with fury as food-eater doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

11. 21. As he moved out toward progeny, Prajāpati ('lord of progeny'), coming into being, moved out after, making breath [his] food-eater; 22. with breath as food-eater doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

12. 23. As he moved out toward all the intermediate directions, the most exalted one, coming into being, moved out after, making the bráhman [his] food-eater; 24. with the bráhman as food-eater doth he eat food who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ॥
verses.rom: tasya vratyasya ||
verses.en: Of that Vrātya—

verses.sa: सप्त प्राणाः सप्तापानाः सप्त व्यानाः ॥
verses.rom: sapta pranah saptapanah sapta vyanah ||
verses.en: [There are] seven breaths, seven expirations (apāná), seven outbreathings (vyāná).

verses.sa: योऽस्य प्रथमः प्राण ऊर्ध्वो नामायं सो अग्निः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya prathamah prana urdhvo namayam so agnih ||
verses.en: His breath that is first, upward by name, that is this fire.

verses.sa: योऽस्य द्वितीयः प्राणः प्रौढो नामासौ स आदित्यः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya dvitiyah pranah praudho namasau sa adityah ||
verses.en: His breath that is second, preferred (? prāúḍha) by name, that is yon sun (ādityá).

verses.sa: योऽस्य तृतीयः प्राणोऽभ्यूढो नामासौ स चन्द्रमाः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya tritiyah prano'bhyudho namasau sa chandramah ||
verses.en: His breath that is third, inferred (? abhyū̀ḍha) by name, that is yon moon.

verses.sa: योऽस्य चतुर्थः प्राणो विभूर्नामायं स पवमानः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya chaturthah prano vibhurnamayam sa pavamanah ||
verses.en: His breath that is fourth, mighty (vibhū́) by name, that is this cleansing one (pávamāna).

verses.sa: योऽस्य पञ्चमः प्राणो योनिर्नाम ता इमा आपः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya panchamah prano yonirnama ta ima apah ||
verses.en: His breath that is fifth, womb (? yóni) by name, that is these waters.

verses.sa: योऽस्य षष्ठः प्राणः प्रियो नाम त इमे पशवः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya shashthah pranah priyo nama ta ime pashavah ||
verses.en: His breath that is sixth, dear by name, that is these cattle.

verses.sa: योऽस्य सप्तमः प्राणोऽपरिमितो नाम ता इमाः प्रजाः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya saptamah prano'parimito nama ta imah prajah ||
verses.en: His breath that is seventh, unlimited by name, that is these creatures (prajā́).

verses.sa: योऽस्य प्रथमोऽपानः सा पौर्णमासी ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya prathamo'panah sa paurnamasi ||
verses.en: His expiration that is first, that is the day of full moon.

verses.sa: योऽस्य द्वितीयोऽपानः साष्टका ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya dvitiyo'panah sashtaka ||
verses.en: His expiration that is second, that is the day of the moon's quarter (áṣṭakā).

verses.sa: योऽस्य तृतीयोऽपानः सामावास्या ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya tritiyo'panah samavasya ||
verses.en: His expiration that is third, that is the day of new moon.

verses.sa: योऽस्य चतुर्थोऽपानः सा श्रद्धा ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya chaturtho'panah sa shraddha ||
verses.en: His expiration that is fourth, that is faith.

verses.sa: योऽस्य पञ्चमोऽपानः सा दीक्षा ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya panchamo'panah sa diksha ||
verses.en: His expiration that is fifth, that is consecration.

verses.sa: योऽस्य षष्ठोऽपानः स यज्ञः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya shashtho'panah sa yajnah ||
verses.en: His expiration that is sixth, that is sacrifice.

verses.sa: योऽस्य सप्तमोऽपानस्ता इमा दक्षिणाः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya saptamo'panasta ima dakshinah ||
verses.en: His expiration that is seventh, that is these sacrificial gifts.

verses.sa: योऽस्य प्रथमो व्यानः सेयं भूमिः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya prathamo vyanah seyam bhumih ||
verses.en: His out-breathing that is first, that is this earth.

verses.sa: योऽस्य द्वितीयो व्यानस्तदन्तरिक्षम् ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya dvitiyo vyanastadantariksham ||
verses.en: His out-breathing that is second, that is the atmosphere.

verses.sa: योऽस्य तृतीयो व्यानः सा द्यौः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya tritiyo vyanah sa dyauh ||
verses.en: His out-breathing that is third, that is the sky.

verses.sa: योऽस्य चतुर्थो व्यानस्तानि नक्षत्राणि ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya chaturtho vyanastani nakshatrani ||
verses.en: His out-breathing that is fourth, that is the asterisms.

verses.sa: योऽस्य पञ्चमो व्यानस्त ऋतवः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya panchamo vyanasta ritavah ||
verses.en: His out-breathing that is fifth, that is the seasons.

verses.sa: योऽस्य षष्ठो व्यानस्त आर्तवाः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya shashtho vyanasta artavah ||
verses.en: His out-breathing that is sixth, that is they of the seasons.

verses.sa: योऽस्य सप्तमो व्यानः स संवत्सरः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya saptamo vyanah sa samvatsarah ||
verses.en: His out-breathing that is seventh, that is the year.

verses.sa: समानमर्थं परि यन्ति देवाः संवत्सरं वा एतदृतवोऽनुपरियन्ति व्रात्यं च ॥
verses.rom: samanamartham pari yanti devah samvatsaram va etadritavo'nupariyanti vratyam cha ||
verses.en: The gods go about the same purpose (ártha); thus (etát) verily the seasons go about after the year and the Vrātya.

verses.sa: यदादित्यमभिसंविशन्त्यमावास्यां चैव तत्पौर्णमासीं च ॥
verses.rom: yadadityamabhisamvishantyamavasyam chaiva tatpaurnamasim cha ||
verses.en: As they enter together into the sun (ādityá), just so [do they] also into new-moon day and full-moon day.

verses.sa: एकं तदेषाममृतत्वमित्याहुतिरेव ॥
verses.rom: ekam tadeshamamritatvamityahutireva ||
verses.en: One [is] that immortality of theirs: to this effect (íti) [is] the offering.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ॥
verses.rom: tasya vratyasya ||
verses.en: Of that Vrātya—

verses.sa: यदस्य दक्षिणमक्ष्यसौ स आदित्यो यदस्य सव्यमक्ष्यसौ स चन्द्रमाः ॥
verses.rom: yadasya dakshinamakshyasau sa adityo yadasya savyamakshyasau sa chandramah ||
verses.en: As for (yát) his right eye, that is yonder sun (ādityá) as for his left eye, that is yonder moon.

verses.sa: योऽस्य दक्षिणः कर्णोऽयं सो अग्निर्योऽस्य सव्यः कर्णोऽयं स पवमानः ॥
verses.rom: yo'sya dakshinah karno'yam so agniryo'sya savyah karno'yam sa pavamanah ||
verses.en: As for his right ear, that is this fire; as for his left ear, that is this cleansing one ('wind').

verses.sa: अहोरात्रे नासिके दितिश्चादितिश्च शीर्षकपाले संवत्सरः शिरः ॥
verses.rom: ahoratre nasike ditishchaditishcha shirshakapale samvatsarah shirah ||
verses.en: Day-and-night [are his] two nostrils; Diti and Aditi [his] two skull-halves; the year [his] head.

verses.sa: अह्ना प्रत्यङ्व्रात्यो रात्र्या प्राङ्नमो व्रात्याय ॥
verses.rom: ahna pratyanvratyo ratrya prannamo vratyaya ||
verses.en: With the day [is] the Vrātya westward, with the night eastward: homage to the Vrātya.
